purpose: Resolve current content-eligible Steam rows into purchase families using exact Steam relationships first, then choose one local primary purchase variant per family before expensive external checks.
relationship_priority: Steam DLC fullgame_appid attaches an addon to its exact included base-game family
Steam package with exactly one included base-game component attaches to that exact base-game family
Steam package with multiple included base-game components remains its own bundle/franchise-bundle purchase family rather than forcing unrelated base families to merge
exact normalized title equality after removing only common edition suffixes may group edition variants when an edition marker is actually present
otherwise each eligible game row starts its own purchase family

primary_variant_selection.base_app_vs_single_base_package: prefer the package when it is no more expensive than the base app, or when its incremental cost is at most 25 percent of the base-app price and it contains at least one additional Steam app; otherwise prefer the base app
primary_variant_selection.edition_variants: prefer the cheapest base-containing variant unless a more complete variant costs at most 25 percent more and has explicit additional package/app content
primary_variant_selection.cross_game_bundle: bundle is its own family and is its primary variant

pass_requires: every content-eligible row is assigned to exactly one purchase family
each family has exactly one primary variant
DLC rows never become primary when their included base exists
all grouping relationships have exact mechanical evidence
no grouping is based only on shared franchise words
assigned row count equals stage 12 eligible count
